custom_emojis.title.description: Title of the settings page of the custom emoji that the user requests and made.

custom_emojis.description.defaultMessage: 你的角色允許你在這個伺服器新增自訂表情符號。每個申請都會先經過管理員審查，表情符號才會顯示出來。只要你的角色允許，你就可以變更和刪除自己建立的表情符號。上限是以你每月送出的申請數計算，因此刪除表情符號不會空出名額。
custom_emojis.description.description: Explanation at the top of the user's custom emoji page (ADR-0070).

custom_emojis.new.title.description: Heading of the region of the form that requests a new custom emoji.

custom_emojis.usage.label.description: Label of the meter of how many custom emoji the user requested this month (UTC) against their monthly limit.

custom_emojis.usage.value.defaultMessage: {full, select, true {{used, number} / {limit, number}，已達上限{pending, plural, =0 {} other {，其中 # 個待審查}}} other {{used, number} / {limit, number}{pending, plural, =0 {} other {，其中 # 個待審查}}}}
custom_emojis.usage.value.description: The value of the meter of the requests to create a custom emoji that the user submitted this month (UTC). {used} counts the approved and pending ones; {pending} is how many of them are pending; {limit} is how many they may submit in a month; {full} is true when they reached it.

custom_emojis.usage.unlimited.defaultMessage: {used, plural, other {你本月申請了 # 個自訂表情符號}}{pending, plural, =0 {} other {，其中 # 個待審查}}。你的角色沒有設定上限。
custom_emojis.usage.unlimited.description: How many custom emoji the user requested this month (UTC) when their roles set no limit. {used} counts the approved and pending requests to create one; {pending} is how many of them are pending.

custom_emojis.usage.resets.description: When the count of the monthly custom emoji limit resets, under its meter. {date} is the formatted date and time in the viewer's time zone, for example 'November 1, 2026 at 9:00 AM'.

custom_emojis.image.description: Label of the image of a requested custom emoji.

custom_emojis.image.description.defaultMessage: PNG、GIF 或 WebP，每邊最多 1,024 像素。會以 256 像素以內顯示；動態 PNG 只會顯示第一格。
custom_emojis.image.description.description: Rules of the image of a requested custom emoji.

custom_emojis.image.choose.description: Button that opens the file picker for the image of a requested custom emoji.

custom_emojis.image.chosen.description: The chosen image file. {name} is its file name.

custom_emojis.image.large_hint.defaultMessage: 這張圖片大於 100 KB。有些伺服器（GoToSocial 預設如此）不會顯示這麼大的自訂表情符號。
custom_emojis.image.large_hint.description: Hint for an image of a requested custom emoji larger than 100 KB.

custom_emojis.image.required.description: Error of a request without an image.

custom_emojis.image_failed.defaultMessage: 伺服器無法處理這張圖片。
custom_emojis.image_failed.description: Error when the server could not process the uploaded image of a custom emoji request.

custom_emojis.shortcode.description: Label of the shortcode of a requested custom emoji.

custom_emojis.shortcode.description.defaultMessage: 2 到 30 個英文字母（A 到 Z）、數字和底線；區分大小寫。使用時以冒號包住，例如 :blobcat:。之後無法變更。
custom_emojis.shortcode.description.description: Rules of the shortcode of a requested custom emoji.

custom_emojis.shortcode.invalid.defaultMessage: 請使用 2 到 30 個英文字母（A 到 Z）、數字和底線。
custom_emojis.shortcode.invalid.description: Error of a shortcode that breaks the rules.

custom_emojis.submit.description: Button that sends a request for a new custom emoji.

custom_emojis.requested.defaultMessage: 已申請 {emoji}。管理員會進行審查。
custom_emojis.requested.description: Status after requesting a custom emoji. {emoji} is its :shortcode:.

custom_emojis.request_failed.description: Error of a custom emoji request that failed. {reason} is the server's explanation, such as a taken shortcode or a reached limit.

custom_emojis.requests.title.description: Heading of the region of the user's custom emoji requests.

custom_emojis.requests.empty.description: Empty state of the user's custom emoji requests.

custom_emojis.withdraw.description: Button that withdraws a pending custom emoji request.

custom_emojis.withdraw_request.description: Accessible name of the button that withdraws a pending custom emoji request. {emoji} is the :shortcode: of the requested emoji.

custom_emojis.withdrawn.description: Status after withdrawing a custom emoji request.

custom_emojis.withdraw_failed.description: Error after withdrawing a custom emoji request failed. {reason} is the server's explanation.

custom_emojis.list.title.defaultMessage: 你建立的自訂表情符號
custom_emojis.list.title.description: Heading of the region of the custom emoji that the user made.

custom_emojis.empty.defaultMessage: 你還沒有建立任何自訂表情符號
custom_emojis.empty.description: Empty state of the custom emoji that the user made.

custom_emojis.empty.description.defaultMessage: 核准的申請會顯示在這裡。
custom_emojis.empty.description.description: Description of the empty state of the custom emoji that the user made.

custom_emojis.state.description: Term of the description list of the user's custom emoji: whether it is shown.

custom_emojis.state.enabled.description: State of an enabled custom emoji.

custom_emojis.state.disabled.defaultMessage: 已被管理員停用：以文字顯示
custom_emojis.state.disabled.description: State of a custom emoji that an administrator disabled.

custom_emojis.picker.description: Term of the description list of the user's custom emoji: whether the picker offers it.

custom_emojis.picker.hidden.description: The picker does not offer the emoji.

custom_emojis.category.description: Label of the category of a custom emoji.

custom_emojis.category.description.defaultMessage: 在選擇器中將表情符號分組。選填，最多 {max} 個字元。
custom_emojis.category.description.description: Description of the category of a custom emoji. {max} is the limit.

custom_emojis.aliases.description: Label of the other names of a custom emoji.

custom_emojis.aliases.description.defaultMessage: 選擇器搜尋時也能用來找到這個表情符號的名稱，以空格或逗號分隔；最多 {max} 個，格式同短代碼。
custom_emojis.aliases.description.description: Description of the other names of a custom emoji. {max} is the limit.

custom_emojis.aliases.too_many.description: Error of too many other names.

custom_emojis.visible_in_picker.description: Checkbox: whether the picker offers the emoji.

custom_emojis.visible_in_picker.descript.defaultMessage: 即使在選擇器中隱藏，仍然可以輸入 :shortcode: 使用。
custom_emojis.visible_in_picker.descript.description: Description of the checkbox of the picker.

custom_emojis.none.description: Value of an empty category or empty other names.

custom_emojis.updated_at.description: Term of the description list of the user's custom emoji: when its current image was set.

custom_emojis.edit.description: Button that opens the dialog of the settings of the user's custom emoji.

custom_emojis.edit_emoji.description: Accessible name of the edit button. {emoji} is the emoji's :shortcode:.

custom_emojis.edit.title.description: Title of the dialog of the settings of the user's custom emoji.

custom_emojis.edit.close.description: Close button of the edit dialog.

custom_emojis.save.description: Button that saves the settings of the user's custom emoji.

custom_emojis.cancel.description: Button that closes a dialog of the user's custom emoji.

custom_emojis.updated.description: Status after saving the settings of the user's custom emoji.

custom_emojis.request_image.description: Button that picks a new image of the user's custom emoji and requests it.

custom_emojis.request_image_of.description: Accessible name of the button that requests a new image. {emoji} is the emoji's :shortcode:.

custom_emojis.image_requested.defaultMessage: 已申請 {emoji} 的新圖片。管理員會進行審查；在此之前表情符號會維持原本的圖片。
custom_emojis.image_requested.description: Status after requesting a new image of the user's custom emoji.

custom_emojis.delete.description: Button that deletes the user's custom emoji, and the confirm button of its dialog.

custom_emojis.delete_emoji.description: Accessible name of the delete button. {emoji} is the emoji's :shortcode:.

custom_emojis.delete.title.description: Title of the dialog that confirms deleting the user's custom emoji.

custom_emojis.delete.description.defaultMessage: 使用它的貼文和個人檔案會將 {emoji} 顯示為文字，它也不再計入你的上限。這項操作無法復原。
custom_emojis.delete.description.description: Description of the dialog that confirms deleting the user's custom emoji.

custom_emojis.deleted.description: Status after deleting the user's custom emoji.

custom_emojis.change_failed.defaultMessage: 無法變更自訂表情符號：{reason}
custom_emojis.change_failed.description: Error after a change of the user's custom emoji failed. {reason} is the server's explanation.
